main_text.l: Iosephi filium fuisse ex ipsis مسلمون ونصاري
ويهود ومن لا دين لهم alios professione Mohammedistas,

l.i: alios Christianos, alios Iudaeos, alios nulli prorsus

main_text.l: Wafel Ebn Ata] ابو حذيفه واصل بن عطا
Wafel Ebn Ata Motazelus, vulgo AlGazzal dictus, natus
Averroes] ابو الوليد محمد بن احمد
بن محمد بن رشد Abul Walid Mohammed Ebn Ahmed
Ebn Mohammed Ebn Rofhd. Obiit anno H. 595.
Ech-wanoffapha] q.d. Fratres sinceri. inde ut
videtur, libro titulus quod qui ipsum composuerint
fraterno inter se amore conjuncti vixerint. de
quibus haec inter alia, habet Gregorius noster زعموا انه متي ادتظمت الفلسفة اليونانية والشريعة العربية فقد حصل الكمال وصنفوا خمسين رسالة في خمسين ذوعامن الحكمة
ومقالة حادية وخمسين جامعة لادراع المقالات علي طريق الاختصار والايجاز وسموها رسايل اخوان الصفا وكتموا فيها اسماءهم Autu-marunt conjunctis Philosophia Graca, & lege

l.i: Arabica ad perfectionem pervenire; composuerunt que 50
epistolas de 50 sapientiae speciebus, addita 51a quae
reliquorum capitum species in unum collecta contineret, juxta
viam compendii & Epitomes, & vocarunt eas Epistolas
Ech-wanoffapha, celatis interim nominibus suis. Sunt

page.notes: Arabic words in the Gregorius passage and the first Arabic line are transcribed from a small scan and may contain minor errors. The Latin "Graca" is printed without a cedilla. The "a" in "51a" is a superscript. The Wafel Arabic line is set right to left across two lines and was read as one. Numbers 193, 195, 196 and 207 stand in the right-hand column beside their entries.
